summary: Added _SAPIENCE_NOTE to home.activation.claudeSettings's enforced-key array (modules/home/core/dotfiles.nix) and extended its comment block with the detection-vs-reversion siting record; appended one pointer sentence to config/claude/settings.json's _SAPIENCE_NOTE value. Verified with a real home-manager switch: the live _SAPIENCE_NOTE now matches source verbatim, the live file carries exactly one Sapience hook entry with no .sapience/mcp.py command, sapienceHooksGuard ran and reported no reinjection, and scripts/check-sapience-hooks.sh exits 0.

artifacts.summary: Implementation summary with observed live-state verification and the recorded siting decision.

completion_data.completion_summary: Closed the recurrence gap left by task 138's Sapience hook removal: _SAPIENCE_NOTE is now an enforced key so the live settings.json note can no longer drift from source, with the detection-vs-reversion siting decision recorded durably in both edited files. A real home-manager switch confirmed convergence end-to-end.

sapience_notes.subject: dotfiles home.activation.claudeSettings enforced-key list
sapience_notes.value: Added _SAPIENCE_NOTE to the enforced-key array (now _NOTE, _SAPIENCE_NOTE, env, hooks, model, permissions, statusLine) so the live note text in ~/.claude/settings.json can no longer drift from config/claude/settings.json's source copy. Rationale recorded inline: a stale live note was found actively misinforming a reader about which mechanism guards against which vendor hook.

sapience_notes.subject: sapienceHooksGuard vs claudeSettings activation ordering
sapience_notes.value: The automatic between-activations detector (sapienceHooksGuard, scripts/check-sapience-hooks.sh) must run entryBefore claudeSettings so it reads the live file BEFORE the enforced-key merge; an inverted ordering, or a detector built inside claudeSettings itself, would inspect an already-cleaned file and look like a working check while detecting nothing.

sapience_notes.subject: home.activation.claudeSettings enforced-key reset on vendor-injected hooks
sapience_notes.value: Reproduced empirically (not just reasoned): the claudeSettings jq merge's reduce over ENFORCED does a flat .hooks = $src.hooks whenever source declares hooks, which fully strips any vendor-injected hook entries on every switch with no additional stripping code needed. A live home-manager switch in this task's own run exercised this against a real (already-converged) live file and confirmed hooks came out identical to source.

sapience_notes.subject: sapience mcp.py vendor hook reinjection timing
sapience_notes.value: A specific dated measurement of vendor-injected hooks (three mcp.py SessionStart/SessionEnd/Stop entries observed 2026-11-14) had already stopped describing live state by 2026-11-18, four days later, with no manual intervention recorded in between -- confirms such snapshots are time-sensitive and must be re-verified against live state rather than cited as current fact in later work.

sapience_notes.subject: running home-manager/nixos-rebuild from inside this agent harness
sapience_notes.value: sudo is categorically denied by this session's permission system, so only a user-level `home-manager switch --flake .#<user>` can be run from inside an agent dispatch; the NixOS-integrated generation (sudo nixos-rebuild switch) stays unapplied until a human runs it, even though home.activation itself (including the activation entries this task edited) is fully exercised by the user-level switch alone.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-deploy.sh gate battery on a deploy-consumer repository
sapience_notes.value: Running .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh --skip-unchanged against a repository that is a deploy consumer but not the agent-system source store (no agent-system/extensions directory) causes 23 of its ~24 gates to [SKIP] immediately with 'is a deploy consumer, not the source store'; only a handful of consumer-applicable checks (runtime-file tracking policy, routing_hard absence guard) actually run. A full unscoped run there is fast and mostly a no-op, not a meaningful stress test of agent-system machinery.

next_steps: Human checkpoint: run `sudo nixos-rebuild switch` (or equivalent) to bring the NixOS-integrated generation in sync with the user-level home-manager switch already applied in this run.
